newsHighlights.title: China claims first men's football medal in 28 years
newsHighlights.summary: China beat Uzbekistan 4-3 on penalties after a 2-2 draw to win the men's football bronze medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, ending a 28-year wait for a place on the podium.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国队在2-2战平后以点球4-3击败乌兹别克斯坦，夺得爱知-名古屋亚运会男足铜牌，结束了28年无缘奖牌台的等待。

newsHighlights.title: A little martial arts star in the countryside of Anhui
newsHighlights.summary: An Austrian family captivated by the scenery and culture of Yixian county helped their daughter become a young martial arts star in rural Anhui.
newsHighlights.translation: 一个被黟县风光与文化深深吸引的奥地利家庭，让女儿在安徽乡村成长为一名小小的武术明星。

newsHighlights.title: Sojourn living fast growing new sector
newsHighlights.summary: Long-stay travel is booming as foreigners trek into the mountains with locals and share meals, turning short trips into healthy, slow-paced everyday life.
newsHighlights.translation: 旅居式生活正成为快速增长的新业态：外国游客与当地人一起进山徒步、共享餐食，把短暂旅行变成健康、慢节奏的日常生活。

newsHighlights.title: Diving into the details: a chat with perfectionist Chen Yuxi
newsHighlights.summary: Olympic diver Chen Yuxi talks about her perfectionist approach to training, explaining that daily details and mental balance keep her at the top.
newsHighlights.translation: 奥运跳水冠军陈芋汐谈她追求完美的训练方式，称正是日常细节与心态平衡让她保持顶尖水平。

newsHighlights.title: How technology helps keep holiday travel safe and efficient
newsHighlights.summary: Smart systems and real-time data are helping millions of holiday travelers move safely and efficiently across the country.
newsHighlights.translation: 智能系统与实时数据正帮助数百万假期出行者安全、高效地抵达目的地。

quote.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quote.explanation: 爱默生提醒我们，健康是一切成就与享受的基础。无论是在绿茵场上拼搏、在乡村习武，还是放慢脚步去旅居生活，拥有健康的身体与心态，才是最珍贵的财富。

vocabulary.example: China defeated Uzbekistan 4-3 on penalties to claim the bronze medal.
vocabulary.translation: 中国队通过点球大战以4-3击败乌兹别克斯坦，夺得铜牌。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《China claims first men's football medal in 28 years》："China defeated Uzbekistan 4-3 on penalties"。

vocabulary.example: The win ended a 28-year wait for a place on the podium.
vocabulary.translation: 这场胜利结束了长达28年无缘领奖台的等待。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 男足夺牌报道："ending a 28-year wait for a place on the podium"。

vocabulary.example: Captivated by its beautiful natural scenery, the family decided to stay longer.
vocabulary.translation: 被当地秀美的自然风光所吸引，这家人决定多停留一段时间。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《A little martial arts star in the countryside of Anhui》："Captivated by its beautiful natural scenery, rich culture..."。

vocabulary.example: Sojourn living has become a fast growing new sector in China's tourism market.
vocabulary.translation: 旅居生活已成为中国旅游市场中快速增长的新业态。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Sojourn living fast growing new sector》，标题核心词。

vocabulary.example: Getting to know southwestern China has meant trekking with locals into the mountains to pick mushrooms.
vocabulary.translation: 了解中国西南地区，意味着和当地人一起进山徒步采蘑菇。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Sojourn living fast growing new sector》："trekking with locals into the mountains to pick mushrooms"。

vocabulary.example: Diver Chen Yuxi is known as a perfectionist who never stops polishing the smallest details.
vocabulary.translation: 跳水运动员陈芋汐是公认的完美主义者，从不停止打磨最细微的动作细节。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Diving into the details: a chat with perfectionist Chen Yuxi》，标题即含该词。

vocabulary.example: Technology helps keep holiday travel both safe and efficient.
vocabulary.translation: 科技让假期出行既安全又高效。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN《How technology helps keep holiday travel safe and efficient》。

vocabulary.definition: 战役；（体育）参赛历程；有组织的活动
vocabulary.example: China finished its Asian Games campaign with 169 golds.
vocabulary.translation: 中国队以169枚金牌结束了自己的亚运会征程。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN《China finishes Asian Games campaign with 169 golds》。

vocabulary.example: The team claimed the men's football bronze medal after a tense penalty shootout.
vocabulary.translation: 经过紧张的点球大战，球队夺得了男足铜牌。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 男足报道："claim the men's football bronze medal"。

vocabulary.example: Athletes say mental balance is just as important as physical training.
vocabulary.translation: 运动员们说，心态平衡与身体训练同样重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 ChinaDaily 陈芋汐专访中关于训练细节与心态调整（mental balance）的讨论。

pattern.pattern: For + 人, + 动名词短语 + has/have meant + 动名词短语（对某人而言，做某事意味着……）
pattern.example: For Joseph Henry Stern of the United States, getting to know southwestern China has meant trekking with locals into the mountains to pick mushrooms.
pattern.translation: 对美国人约瑟夫·亨利·斯特恩来说，了解中国西南地区就意味着和当地人一起进山徒步采蘑菇。
pattern.usage: 该句型常用于说明某种经历或选择所包含的具体内容与付出。可用于写作开头引出个人体验：For many young people, staying healthy has meant giving up fast food and taking up regular exercise.（对许多年轻人而言，保持健康意味着告别快餐、坚持规律锻炼。）

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）：过去动作对现在的影响
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成，强调过去发生的动作对现在产生的结果或影响，常与 for、since、in recent years 等时间状语连用。当句中出现表示一段时间的状语（如 in 28 years）时，通常用现在完成时来突出“时隔多久才达成”的结果。注意区分：一般过去时只陈述过去事实（China won the medal yesterday），而现在完成时强调与现在的关联（China has claimed its first medal in 28 years）。
examples: China has claimed its first men's football medal in 28 years.
Sojourn living has become a fast growing new sector.

pronunciation.tips: 注意 /e/ 为短元音，舌尖抵下齿，发音短促而清晰；结尾是成音节的 /l/，舌尖抵上齿龈，声音在舌尖处“收住”。小心与 metal /ˈmetl/（金属）混淆：medal 的首音是浊辅音 /d/，metal 是清辅音 /t/。重音都在第一音节。
examples: China claimed its first men's football medal in 28 years.
She hopes to stand on the podium and win a gold medal.

reading.title: Slow Living, Strong Bodies: How Chinese Lifestyles Are Changing
reading.content: From the football pitch to mountain villages, healthy living is becoming part of everyday life in China. This week, China claimed its first men's football medal in 28 years, a moment that inspired millions of young fans to lace up their boots. Meanwhile, in the countryside of Anhui, a little martial arts star shows that exercise can begin in any backyard. A new trend is also taking shape: sojourn living. Instead of rushing through a checklist of sights, travelers now stay for weeks, trekking into mountains, cooking with locals and slowing down their pace of life. Perfectionist athletes like diver Chen Yuxi remind us that health is built on small, daily habits — good sleep, steady training and mental balance. Whether you prefer a penalty shootout or a quiet walk, one thing is clear: taking care of your body is the first step toward taking care of your life.
reading.translation: 从绿茵场到山村，健康生活正成为中国日常的一部分。本周，中国队夺得28年来首枚男足球类奖牌，这一时刻激励了数百万年轻球迷穿上球鞋。与此同时，在安徽乡村，一位小小的武术明星向我们展示：锻炼可以从任何一个后院开始。一种新趋势也正在形成——旅居生活。旅行者不再匆忙打卡景点，而是住上几周，进山徒步、与当地人一起做饭，放慢生活节奏。像跳水运动员陈芋汐这样的完美主义者提醒我们，健康建立在日常小事之上：良好的睡眠、稳定的训练和心态平衡。无论你偏爱点球大战还是安静的散步，有一点是清楚的：照顾好身体，是照顾好人生的第一步。
reading.sourceNote: 本文综合改写自 ChinaDaily《China claims first men's football medal in 28 years》《A little martial arts star in the countryside of Anhui》《Sojourn living fast growing new sector》《Diving into the details: a chat with perfectionist Chen Yuxi》等报道，用于英语学习目的。
